ai_summary: This document discloses an *inter-se* transfer of 1,64,000 equity shares (0.017% of total) of Asian Paints Limited between promoter group entities via a block deal. Specifically, shares moved from Jalaj Ashwin Dani HUF to Smiti Holding and Trading Company Private Limited, both part of the promoter group. This internal reorganization has no material impact on the overall promoter shareholding or control of Asian Paints, as the aggregate stake of the Promoter and Promoter Group remains unchanged, thus presenting no red flags for external investors.
